caption: The drawing features six hand tools arranged in two rows of three against a plain, light beige background. Each tool consists of a handle and a rotating, spiked or ridged wheel at one end. The tools vary in design and color: the top row includes, from left to right, a dark brown, curved-bladed tool with a ridged wheel at the end; a middle tool that is thinner, also brown, with an almost fan-shaped handle and a similar small, spiked wheel at the end; and a rightmost tool with a darker handle and a more complex, gear-like wheel mechanism at the tip. The bottom row features a left-hand tool with a wooden handle and a round, dark metal spiked wheel; a central tool with a slender, lightly-colored metal handle and two spiked wheels, one at each end; and a rightmost tool with a medium brown wooden handle and a bright, white spiked wheel. The tools are evenly spaced across the canvas, and no additional elements or background details are present.
title: Crimping Wheel
